extraction_notes: Values with qualifier '~' were read from plotted points in the supplied figure images. The paper provides no numerical source tables in the prompt. Fig. 2a-b contains many overlapping selectivity points; only unambiguous or representative readable points are included for non-primary catalysts, while the full primary CeAlOx/Ni/Ni-foam temperature and GHSV series is captured. Page 5 additionally states for the 80,000 h-1 run an alternate mass-normalized STY of 4450 mmol/gcat/h with respect to the mass of CeAlOx/Ni ensemble; the schema permits one rate field, so the volumetric STY 1109 mmolCH4/mLfoam/h is entered and the alternate is noted here. Stability plots reporting methane yield (Fig. 4) were not entered into stability conversion fields because conversion was not the plotted quantity.
